sources.title: About me - Zhongqi FAN
sources.snippet: I recently completed a project on Guided Clustering-based Uncertain Learning (GCUL), a geometry-driven framework for selective classification. The work derives a theoretical feasibility criterion for when cluster-guided rejection can provide positive operational utility, and validates it on real-world emotion classification benchmarks.
